subject: Physics
central_question: How do moving charges and currents create magnetic fields, and how do magnetic fields act on charges, conductors and loops?

known_pitfalls.claim: A magnetic field changes a charge’s kinetic energy.
known_pitfalls.correction: Magnetic force is perpendicular to velocity and does no work.

known_pitfalls.claim: Positive and negative charges deflect in the same direction.
known_pitfalls.correction: The sign of q reverses q(v × B).

known_pitfalls.claim: Magnetic vector products can be treated as ordinary scalar products.
known_pitfalls.correction: Direction from the cross product is essential.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Example 4.1: wire suspended by magnetic force
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter EXERCISES cover Lorentz force, charged-particle motion, current-produced fields, loop torque and galvanometers.
